assumptions: Pricing probabilities (soft20%, filed50%, above30%) are disclosed subjective scenario priors, not fitted historical frequencies or claims about orderbook demand.
Pricing supports derive from the filed range width: soft=[low-width/2, midpoint] with mode low; filed=[midpoint, high] with mode high; above=[high, high+width] with mode high+width/4.
A 10% prior opening return and flat intraday/four-session prior returns are conservative reference assumptions, not verified population averages.
Each path samples one historical IPO and preserves its joint opening/intraday/dayfive log-return pattern before shrinking all three stage returns toward their respective priors.

Effective empirical weight = 0.6/(1+early_eligible_shares/offered_shares). This is an explicit supply-risk sensitivity, not a trained coefficient. Eligibility is an upper bound, not actual selling volume.
The small purposive technology IPO sample and subjective scenario mixture do not establish predictive accuracy or80% empirical interval coverage.
NVIDIA earnings, financing and governance disclosures are context-only; no unsupported sentiment-to-percentage effect is assigned.
model.range_interpretation: 10th/90th percentiles of subjective model scenarios; historical 80% calibration is not established
model.supply_interpretation: Eligible shares are an upper bound, not a claim they will all be sold. The chosen shrinkage channel is a sensitivity assumption, not a fitted causal coefficient.

limitations: No live social data was collected for this frozen run; X credentials remain unverified in this environment.

Publication times on date-only sources are conservative end-of-New-York-day bounds, not invented precise publication times.
Historical prices are a small purposive provider-published sample; full vintage point-in-time backtesting is unavailable.
Model ranges are subjective scenario quantiles, not empirically calibrated 80% intervals.
The diagnostic is conditional on actual offer prices and does not validate this final supply-aware model.
